agreed: All 55 names, descriptions and grades match across Exophase, PowerPyx, GTA Zone and CryptoGames.
27 trophies are visible and 28 are hidden on PlayStation (1 gold hidden, 27 bronze hidden).
Only one trophy is possibly missable: Positive Mental Attitude, and only because of the Chapter 1 meditation.
The platinum takes about 200 hours at difficulty 4/10, in one playthrough, with no online trophies and no glitched trophies.
The 100% checklist is lenient: 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 of 397 stunts, 30 of 40 races, 15 of 18 card sets, 8 of 8 bank vaults.
Cheats disable trophies and saving. There is no mission replay, but there is free-roam after the story.

a.label: PowerPyx
a.text: Each questline stays open after the story; all five finales can be finished in free-roam.

b.label: TechWiser (via CryptoGames)
b.text: The stranger mission chains behind five hidden trophies have windows tied to story progress.

differ.decision: Start each chain when it unlocks and keep it going. That costs nothing and covers the warning either way.
differ.topic: Do the five character questlines stay open after the story?

a.label: PowerPyx
a.text: The final mission is 'Starting From Zero', in Chapter 4; finishing it completes Chapter 4.

b.label: Beebom and CULTR (via CryptoGames)
b.text: The final mission is worded as Chapter 5.

differ.decision: The trophy is 'complete the final mission' either way; only the chapter label differs, not the requirement.
differ.topic: Which chapter holds the final mission?

a.label: CryptoGames (18 Nov)
a.text: In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, Bad Luck, I Guess, The Truth Is Out There and Ten Pin are unconfirmed.

b.label: PowerPyx (20 Nov)
b.text: Four of the five now have played-through steps; only Bad Luck, I Guess is still unknown.

differ.decision: Follow PowerPyx, the fresher, played-through source; the unconfirmed labels are stale.
differ.topic: Five trophies CryptoGames still lists as unconfirmed

a.label: PowerPyx and GTABase
a.text: 18 meditation spots across 10 locations; meditating with both characters at one spot counts double.

b.label: 100% checklist (via CryptoGames)
b.text: Only 15 of the 18 are needed for 100% completion.

differ.decision: Both numbers are right for different things: 18 spots exist, 15 count toward the checklist. The Chapter 1 meditation may or may not be needed for the trophy.
